The *Paṭhamarāga Sutta* ("Greed [1st]", Iti 68) is a short discourse located in the third division (*Tikanipāta*) of the *Itivuttaka* (It 3.19, PTS It 56). The core teaching of the sutta proclaims that one who has abandoned passion, aversion, and delusion (*rāga*, *dosa*, *moha*) is freed from the power and grasp of Māra.
